description: Exact/substring match against all known Copilot Studio error codes and error messages in the register. The fastest path when you have a verbatim error string (e.g. "FlowActionTimedOut"). Returns the matching record(s) with the citable URL.

error.description: The error code or error message, as verbatim as possible.

locale.description: Output and citation language. English fallback when a current German translation is unavailable.

name: lookup_error
title: Look up a verbatim error
